title: Reports from Mashhad, Iran, indicate that a vehicle drove into a nighttime gathering in the Eghbal Lahouri area on September 1, 2026. The gathering was reportedly a pro-IRGC rally. One report describes the driver as being intoxicated. There are conflicting accounts regarding the number of casualties, with some sources mentioning a "very large number". While some reports are treating the incident as a deliberate attack, Iranian media has noted that it is still unclear whether the act was intentional or an accident.
text:
Reports from Mashhad, Iran, indicate that a vehicle drove into a nighttime gathering in the Eghbal Lahouri area on September 1, 2026. The gathering was reportedly a pro-IRGC rally. One report describes the driver as being intoxicated. There are conflicting accounts regarding the number of casualties, with some sources mentioning a "very large number". While some reports are treating the incident as a deliberate attack, Iranian media has noted that it is still unclear whether the act was intentional or an accident."

"The Governor of Khorasan Razavi issued an order to follow up and address the incident on Vakilabad Boulevard in Mashhad."

"🔹According to the Public Relations Department of the Governor's Office of Khorasan Razavi, as reported by the Mashhad Traffic Police, a Genesis vehicle veered at high speed on Vakilabad Boulevard hours ago and subsequently struck a gathering of people."

"🔹In this incident, 4 people died and more than 10 were injured."

"🔹The driver of the vehicle was arrested after the incident.
